answer: Because the ledge weight is recomputed from the ember history each close, the trellis audit publishes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 7 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 28% of full weight. Running a farm hence buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 18 dollars per alias.
